'''Willim of Maneches''' (sometimes '''Manaches''') was a famous essayist.

== History ==
He influenced many writers, including [[Shivena Kayenzi]].{{ref/book|0|8}}

''[[The Essays of Willim of Maneches]]'' can be found almost anywhere. Copies of the book are in possession of [[Basel Gill]], [[Ailhuin Guenna]], and [[Loial]].{{ref/book|1|36}}{{ref/book|3|49}}{{ref/book|10|24}}
